{{Quote|How do you fight it?"''<br /> "''You don't. Mostly - you ''run''.|[[Sek'nos Rath]] and [[Shae Koda]]|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Saarl''', also known as '''Rift Worms''', were large [[Worm/Legends|worm]]-like creatures that were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. These fearsome beasts possessed massive maws that they used to devour their prey. Typically, one did not fight the creatures and tended to run from them.

The [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] encountered these animals following their relocation to Tython by the [[Tho Yor]]. [[Je'daii Master]] [[Quan-Jang]] and his apprentice [[Shae Koda]] attempted to catch one of these worms. The beast almost killed the pair though they managed to survive the encounter. When the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] crashed on Tython, the event led to a powerful [[Force storm (weather)|Force Storm]] being unleashed and a Saarl was able to project [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] due to the phenomena. This specimen attempted to kill Xesh but where it fought [[Sek'nos Rath]], Shae Koda and [[Tasha Ryo]].
